items.title: [ECG] Invitation to Youth Xchange at Singapore Urban Mobility Week 2026 (Co-organised by LTA)
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please take note of the exhibition below. If you're interested in attending, please register at your own accord.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Land Transport Authority (LTA) would like to invite you to attend
Youth Xchange at the Singapore Urban Mobility Week 2026 (SUMW 2026) exhibition
on
6 November 2026 (Friday)
at the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre.
Co-organised by LTA, SUMW is our international flagship urban mobility event, bringing together transport leaders and industry players from across Asia Pacific and beyond.
As part of the Youth Engagement Programme at SUMW 2026, Youth Xchange offers students the opportunity to explore a vibrant exhibition space where technology and creativity come together through interactive exhibits, games, project showcases and artwork. Students can also discover innovations from over 300 exhibitors & partners across the urban mobility ecosystem, while gaining exposure to emerging transport technologies, sustainability initiatives and future mobility solutions shaping the cities of tomorrow.
We would appreciate it if you could share this opportunity with your students through your school's communication channels.
Event Details
Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre
6 November 2026 (Friday)
8.30am – 5.00pm
Complimentary admission
Please find the Youth Xchange EDM attached. You may register using the QR code provided in the EDM.
Thank you and we look forward to welcoming you to SUMW 2026.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department

items.title: [ECG] - [RSVP] NUS CDE Sustainable Housing Materials and Technology Workshop, 8 – 11 Dec 2026
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please take note of the Workshop below organised by
NUS CDE
. If you're interested, please register and attend at your own accord.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dear Students,
The College of Design and Engineering (CDE), National University of Singapore, is excited to present the
Sustainable Housing Materials & Technology Workshop,
happening from
8 to 11 December 2026
.
Step into the world of the built environment! Get inspired to rethink the future of housing and cities through fun, hands-on activities, interactive lectures by university professors, and live demonstrations at NUS CDE. Discover how sustainable materials and smart technologies come together to build greener, smarter homes and communities.
Our workshop brings together the best of both worlds, blending architectural design with technological innovation and various engineering programmes.
This workshop is open to:
Singapore Citizen students
in
local JC, Poly, NUSHS and IB schools.
Please register
HERE
. Sign-ups are now open till
2 November 2026, 2359.
For more information, check out the poster below or visit our
website
! If you have any questions, please contact us at
cde_outreach@nus.edu.sg
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.
Best regards,
Justin
ECG Department
